April 27, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Beach Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 30.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beach Investment Management Llc bought 2,480 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,690 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.81 million, up from 8,210 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beach Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $817.20B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.93% or $3.164 during the last trading session, reaching $161.056. About 13.59M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
